subject.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel

question: Should Android Settings expose Skill Workshop apply/reject/quarantine actions now, using the existing Gateway proposal RPCs and `operator.admin` gate?
rationale: The implementation is technically consistent with current Gateway contracts, but adding a mobile admin proposal-review surface is a product/owner decision rather than a deterministic repair decision.

options.title: Accept Android parity
options.body: Land the PR after normal merge gates because it reuses existing Gateway contracts and preserves admin-scope mutation gating.

options.title: Read-only first
options.body: Ask for Android list/inspect support only and defer mutation controls until mobile administration is explicitly accepted.

options.title: Keep administration off Android
options.body: Defer or close the PR if proposal lifecycle actions should remain limited to Web/Desktop and CLI surfaces for now.

recommendation.title: Accept Android parity
recommendation.body: Land the PR after normal merge gates because it reuses existing Gateway contracts and preserves admin-scope mutation gating.

likelyOwner.reason: Solvely-Colin is the current assignee and has recent Android Settings/ShellScreen history, making them the best available owner for the immediate maintainer choice.
